crossRefs.note: “If a man steals an ox or a sheep, and kills it or sells it, he shall pay five oxen for an ox, and four sheep for a…
but if he is found, he shall restore seven times. He shall give all the wealth of his house.
Zacchaeus stood and said to the Lord, “Behold, Lord, half of my goods I give to the poor. If I have wrongfully exacted…
For judgment is without mercy to him who has shown no mercy. Mercy triumphs over judgment.

translations.web: He must restore the lamb fourfold, because he did this thing, and because he had no pity!”
translations.bsb: Because he has done this thing and has shown no pity, he must pay for the lamb four times over.”
translations.kjv: And he shall restore the lamb fourfold, because he did this thing, and because he had no pity.
translations.asv: and he shall restore the lamb fourfold, because he did this thing, and because he had no pity.
